blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Golden State Warriors star Stephen Curry has started individual on-court workouts, but will miss at least the next three games as he recovers from a torn oblique muscle. Curry has missed the last six games since suffering the injury against Houston on Nov. 11 and was re-evaluated prior to Friday night’s game at Portland. READ: ‘Concern is high’ as Steph Curry exits with abdominal soreness The Warriors said Curry is making progress and will be re-evaluated against next Wednesday.
